positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – AI Trainer
positions.description:
Work with Cutting Edge Agents
• Vibe Coding with Claude Code and Codex.
• Using AI agents to refactor code, find and fix security
vulnerabilities, implement new features, fix defects, and start
new projects
• Found, documented and created rubrics for various failure
modes and mis-alignments
• Evaluate AI output in a variety of coding languages for a variety
of software engineering applications.
• Training AI models to produce better more effective code
• Training and evaluating AI models for various productivity tasks
• Correcting AI agent initiated work

positions.title: Software Dev Engineer IV.
positions.description:
• Building solutions to ingest and transform PDF contract data into structured JSON formats, enabling data-driven automation and analytics.
• Developing scalable, multi-tiered applications using object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and distributed programming techniques.
• Leading the end-to-end delivery of complex software components, from architecture and implementation to testing, documentation, and deployment.
• Translating business and functional requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and implement supportable, maintainable, and well-documented software solutions.
• Driving engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle, including code quality, system design, and technical leadership.
• Contributing to modern full-stack development initiatives using technologies such as TypeScript, React, AWS, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Exploring and building AI-powered solutions and intelligent agents to improve automation and business efficiency.

positions.title: Assistant Director of DevOps
positions.description:
Managing and administering a 2 million dollar AWS budget. Responsible for tracking AWS costs and increasing efficiency by right sizing AWS resources, reducing waste, and ensuring proper backup policies of important data. Introduced Wiz.io to greatly reduce the number of security vulnerabilities and prevent new ones from persisting in production. Implemented automation to automatically recover critical tools scientists use to do research and create new products. 

As the Assistant Director, Development Operations I am responsible for leading a DevOps transformation, educating the team on best DevOps practices as well as directing efforts to implement them. Running standup for the DevOps team, defining objectives and Epics in Jira, writing Jira stories, and peer reviewing changes are part of the daily function. I also serve as architect of the Ansible project and efforts to tie together automation primarily using Jenkins with Bitbucket pipelines and other technologies. 

Responsible for database administration of our multiple data stores. Databases technologies I administer include, but are not limited do, Couch Db, Oracle, AWS Aurora, AWS Neptune, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. This includes making sure databases are backed up and that Dev instances of said databases exist with current data.

Oversaw the deployment of a new inventory application developed in Type Script with Node.js and React and graphQL using a PostgreSQL back-end deployed with AWS CLI tools. Regularly work with apps developed in Node.js, Angular, React, and Python. Currently developing a behavioral testing framework using Cucumber. Responsible for administering Oracle, PostgreSQL, and CouchDB databases for Functional Genomics. Responsible for administering Jira and Bitbucket.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Containerization · Linux · Jenkins · Web Development · TypeScript · Git · REST · IT Infrastructure Design · PostgreSQL · Oracle Database · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Principal Dev Ops Engineer
positions.description:
As the Principal Dev Ops Engineer my duties include maintaining and deploying environments from Development to Production for North America, Europe, and Australia. This involves maintaining various ansible, bash, and pipeline scripts to facilitate those deploys. My duties also include maintaining the build pipelines, and developing and maintaining various tools to help developers accomplish their tasks more efficiently. 

I created a build system with Jenkins that runs unit tests on multiple PHP repositories, consistently tests database update scripts across 4 distinct regional MSSQL databases, runs Cucumber tests against a SeleniumGrid, and merges branches on completion of a successful build. PHPUnit tests for multiple projects as well as Cucumber User Acceptance Tests (UAT) are run in parallel. I also created the initial Java Cucumber project and guided QA resources in making proper behavioral web acceptance tests. Wrote a custom database update command in the PHP Symfony project for T-SQL updates on lower environments as well as to gather update scripts for deployment as Doctrine versioning did not fit business needs. Created and maintains ansible project which is used to setup and provision CI, Dev, Stage, Sandbox, QA, and Production environments. Developed custom jenkins plugins such as a custom bitBucket integration plugin.

Responsible for setting up new web nodes for North America, Australia, New Zealand, and European countries. Responsible for all major code deployments and updates to those web nodes for Norwex. Refactored deployment scripts to maintain consistency between testing and production while reducing deployment times up to 80% in production and QA environments and as much as 60% in development environments. Responsible for setting up release branches, and working with QA to decide when releases are ready. I also assist developers with issues they encounter with git, setting up new countries, and writing proper unit tests.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
My primary responsibilities at Norwex included developing new features and fixing bugs in an international multi-language web application. The application is written in PHP using the symfony framework and uses Microsoft's MSSQL as it's relational database. Worked on supporting applications written with C# that handle specific business critical tasks not in the web application. This involves using the Atlassian suite of products to manage work flow and regularly reviewing pull requests while offering meaningful feedback when needed. 

Was flown down to Australia to train developers in the Norwex development process. On-boarded and trained new developers to work on the Norwex applications. Was flown to Germany to oversee a major code deployment to EU countries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created a RESTful map request caching service to minimize redundant calls to mapquest cutting our usage by two thirds allowing our business to renegotiate a more favorable contract with that vendor. 

Develop new features for and maintain Cox Automotive Logistics products jTracker and CentralDispatch in a scrum/agile environment. Doing so requires working with multiple technologies including Zend Framework, Bootstrap 3.x, jQuery, and MooTools. Participate in design session to properly implement new services or refactor old ones. 

Corrected issues with tests from a legacy build system using cruise control to work properly with a new next level automation system that uses Atlassian products tied in with Git and Jenkins. Corrected many of the existing PHPUnit and Selenium Tests to ensure both proper code coverage and that important business functionality was represented. Worked with multiple Product Owners to understand the value of various functionality covered in the tests as well as their goals to ensure proper coverage. Developed new PHPUnit unit and integration tests to ensure proper code coverage of new and extended functionality as it was developed.
positions.insights: Skills: IBM Db2 · Linux · PHP · Jenkins · Web Development · Responsive Web Design · Git · REST

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Minimized calls to MapQuest saving the company hundreds of thousands a month.  Responsible for a good portion of the work to convert Central Dispatch to a responsive design with Bootstrap. 

Develop new features for and maintain Dealertrack Transportation products jTracker and CentralDispatch in a scrum/agile environment. Doing so requires working with multiple technologies including Zend Framework, Bootstrap 3.x, jQuery, and MooTools. Participate in design session to properly implement new services or refactor old ones.

Worked with multiple Product Owners to understand the value of various functionality covered in the tests as well as their goals to ensure proper coverage. Developed new PHPUnit unit and integration tests to ensure proper code coverage of new and extended functionality as it was developed. 

Level 3 support Triage to help bridge any gaps between support and development to help solve issues or make sure those issues are understood so that said issues are properly groomed for sprint planning.
positions.insights: Skills: IBM Db2 · Linux · PHP · Web Development · Responsive Web Design · Git

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Updated a large legacy PHP 5.2 code base to be PHP 5.4 complaint. This included managing all new changes that came in to make sure they were 5.4 compliant or make the appropriate corrections if they were not. I managed the new branch for the PHP 5.4 code, the merge of this code back into trunk when it was complete, and participated in the testing and deployment of a new server environment needed for the upgrade.

Completed several other projects to add new features or improve the user experience of the companies custom web to print site. Technologies used include Doctrine ORM and various Symfony components. Code was version controlled with SVN. Daily activities included being first responder on level 2 and level 3 support as well as regularly  meeting with sales support staff to understand and resolve various issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · PHP · MySQL · Web Development

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Worked on a web site with 7 million page views a month. Created multiple web applications and niche sites primarily using PHP and MySQL while hand coding thousands of lines of CSS and HTML. Managed a dedicated server running a LAMP stack. Used available technologies such as Joomla and WordPress as well as custom solutions depending on what was best suited to the situation. Designed and developed multiple web applications using MVC frameworks, primarily Codeigniter, including a system to generate and manage content for our Spanish Language Android App Somos Frontera. Developed multiple scripts to generate and process XML content. Developed our Spanish Language Android App Somos Frontera and participated in the creation of apps for El Paso Times.com which combined have 4 million monthly page views. Collaborated with management from several departments to complete projects such as the Daily Deal in El Paso and in several New Mexico Markets.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · PHP · MySQL · Web Development · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the entire Systems Development Life-cycle (SDLC) of projects often starting with the sales call to gather user requirements and prototype. This often included ongoing support and followups to up sell additional work and provide customer satisfaction.Occasionally lead a team that included part timers to accomplish larger projects. 

Coded in multiple languages to accomplish tasks including Flash Action Script 2.0 and 3.0, Visual Basic, JAVA, C/C++, PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and Java Script. Developed or edited e-commerce sites based on Zend Cart, OSCommerce, and Geodesic GeoCore. Translated designer PSDs to templates for CMS software such as Joomla, Mambo, PHP List, and Dolphin. Managed web hosting services on a LAMP Stack.

positions.title: IT Professional
positions.description: Evaluated customers needs, suggested solutions to address those needs, and implemented those solutions. Services provided included, web design, developing web sites, PC tech support, help desk, networking, web hosting, and editing stand alone applications. Managed web hosting services on a LAMP Stack. Created web pages using Flash, PHP, MySQL, Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Edited legacy applications in Visual Basic, C++, and Java. Handled walk in business as well as cold calling. Integrated an OSCommerce instance into an existing site based on phpFox for e-commerce.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · MySQL · Web Development · Java
